title: Summer Research Internship Program for High School Students
sponsor: LSU Health Sciences Center New Orleans, School of Medicine
pay_text: $2,645 stipend for high school students, paid in three parts
who_text: High school juniors and seniors aged 16 to 18 who live in or near New Orleans for the summer and can attend all eight weeks
description: A paid eight-week summer research job in New Orleans. You work in a lab with LSU Health faculty and graduate students, attend weekly seminars, and present a poster at the end. Students pay for parking if they drive.
